# Proverbs 10 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 10:2 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Treasures-of wickedness do-not-profit, but-righteousness delivers from-death. |
| LOGOS | Treasures gained by wickedness do not profit, but righteousness delivers from death. |
| PNEUMA | Wealth gained dishonestly does you no good, but doing right can save your life. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 10:3 (overlap: 0%)

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | Not will-YHWH-let-hunger the-soul-of [the]-righteous, but-[the]-desire-of [the]-wicked He-pushes-away. |
| LOGOS | The LORD does not let the righteous go hungry, but He thwarts the craving of the wicked. |
| PNEUMA | The LORD won't let a good person starve, but He blocks what the wicked crave. |

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
